note: Moon Meadow World's ElevenLabs sound effects and background loops (docs/v4/2.3.md Part 2, sections 7 and 8). tools/audio/gen-sfx.py makes the ones without a file in public/audio/sfx/, calling POST /v1/sound-generation with duration_seconds always set, and books seconds x sfxPerSecond into tools/audio/ledger.jsonl. The API has no seed: a made file is kept and only --retake makes it again. Tjitse listens to every file and sets approved. core marks the eight that stay if the probe costs more than planned.

effects.text: A small magical egg cracking open: three gentle shell cracks, then a soft sparkly chime. Cartoon, for a children's game. No voice, no music.
A tiny baby pony giving a short, happy, gentle nicker. Cute and soft, close up. No music.
A baby horse's soft, happy little whinny, very short and high. Cute, close up. No music.
A small wooden stable half door swinging open with a soft creak and a gentle wooden knock. No voice.
An old wooden toy chest lid creaking open, then a short magical sparkle shimmer. Warm and gentle. No voice.
Soft crinkle of tissue paper as a small present is unwrapped. Gentle, close up. No voice.
A soft swish of a silky princess dress as it twirls. Gentle fabric whoosh, close up.
A single small glass bead clicking onto a string: one tiny bright clink.
A magical twinkle of tiny bells and a soft shimmer, like a crown sparkling. Gentle, for a children's game.
Dry hay bundles dropped into a wooden rack: a soft rustle, close up. No animals.
A cheerful big splash as a child slides into a pond: water spray and a few droplets. No voice, no screaming.
A playful splash into a garden pond: a bright water splash with bubbly droplets. No voice.
A smooth playful whoosh of sliding down a plastic slide, quick and bright. No voice.
A soft evening bell ringing twice in the distance. Warm and calm, bedtime.
A soft friendly owl hooting twice at night, gentle and far away. Calm.
A warm gentle magical shimmer rising up, like a heart starting to glow. Soft and sweet, for a children's game.

loops.text: A calm sunny meadow: soft birdsong far away and a light breeze in the grass. Peaceful. No voices, no music, no sudden sounds.
A calm summer night in a meadow: soft crickets and a light breeze. Peaceful. No owls, no voices, no music, no sudden sounds.
